description: Turn required internal approval before publishing on or off for this workspace (Studio and Pro, admins and owners only). Ask the user before changing workspace approval rules.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

requireApproval.description: true requires internal approval before non-owners can publish or schedule; false allows direct publishing.

name: team_settings_set
title: Set team approval rules
